objective: Explore reduced recurrent retention as a possible way to reduce stair phase-transition delay
selection_basis: Repeat the previous 1.1 update-gate experiment on the new checkpoint; not a simulation-selected optimum
previous_model_caution: The 2650 experiment had mixed closed-loop results; its rear/head edits and physical performance do not transfer to 2850.
environment_contract: Student-A family: 271 observations, GRU256, ELU MLP256/128, 18 actions; exact training task unknown
environment_provenance_limit: Architecture matches the local source; infos=None. Exact training task (A/TopEnd/Mem128/Mem256), asset and commit cannot be proven from weights.

patch.operation: subtract log(candidate_odds) from update-gate input bias
patch.interpretation: At identical x,h, (1-z)/z is multiplied by candidate_odds; this is not a gait speed multiplier

optimizer_note: Retained verbatim for checkpoint compatibility; no optimizer step was taken. This is an inference experiment. Further distillation toward the unchanged teacher can undo the edit.

checks.kind: synthetic network checks, not simulation or locomotion evaluation

limitations: This generator runs network checks only; no physical rollout was run by this script.
The policy needs memory to infer its phase; reduced retention may worsen phase tracking, stability or ascent speed.
Synthetic finite outputs do not demonstrate robot stability, success rate or faster climbing.
No best candidate has been selected from simulation results.

required_comparison.task: Use the original training task; Student-A/TopEnd/Mem128/Mem256 share tensor shapes
required_comparison.controls: Identical environment version, robot asset, seeds, initial poses, action clipping and normalization; deterministic inference; reset GRU between episodes
required_comparison.initial_state: Use phase 0 only for full-ascent timing: stair_reset buffer_ratio=0, x_ranges=((-0.1,0.1),)
required_comparison.selection: Accept only if ascent time improves without a meaningful success-rate or fall-rate regression; count failed and timed-out episodes as well as successes
